items.title: Pelle Larsson was awesome for Sweden in their victory over Finland today: 31 points, 9-17 FG, 11-14 FT, 5 rebounds.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Pelle Larsson was awesome for Sweden in their victory over Finland today: 31 points, 9-17 FG, 11-14 FT, 5 rebounds.

Lauri Markkanen struggled for Finland: 11 points, 2-13 FG, 7-8 FT, 3 rebounds, 2 steals, 1 block.
